{icon} [NORTHERN TEMPEST ESCALATION]: Biting mountain winds descend from the crags of Pohjola, plunging the territory into extreme [{weather}]!

🚧 [HIGHWAY CHOKEPOINT AMBUSH]: Exiled raiders spot your pack from their ridge lookout and snap shut a fortified road gate to the [{direction}], demanding blood or coin!

🔮 [LEYLINE AQUIFER ERUPTION]: Subterranean mana springs burst through ancient stone fissures, showering your exhausted mind in pure liquid ether (+{restoreAmt} MP) and yielding a rare catalyst!
🔮 [ASTRAL FONT RESONANCE]: A dormant astral font hidden within the rockface chimes softly, funneling concentrated arcane currents (+{restoreAmt} MP) and an elemental catalyst into your pack!

encounters.name: Sovereign Light-Guardian

🛡️ [KNIGHT OF ETERNAL LIGHT]: A spectral vanguard spirit sworn to defend valiant souls materializes to the [{direction}], raising its shield in your honor!

encounters.name: Primal Resource Bounty

💰 [GILDED ORE GREMLIN]: Scrambling through loose rubble with bulging pockets of unrefined iron and gold, a greedy Ore Thief scurries to the [{direction}]!

encounters.name: Alchemical Mana Leak
encounters.description: Volatile catalyst fumes react unstably inside your belt pouch, causing an electrical pop that burns away Focus.

💸 [CURSED PURSE DRAIN]: A cursed dungeon draft passes over your pack, dissolving -{goldToll} Gold coins into spectral mist!

encounters.name: Acidic Alloy Tarnish
